instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Use Bonsai's native IFC authoring workflow to create a new IFC4 model containing a single facade wall with hosted doors and windows. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. Save the completed model as result.ifc. The model should have one project, one building storey named Level 00, and no building element proxies. Create exactly one wall named Facade Wall with geometric bounding-box spans of 18.0 m in X, 0.25 m in Y, and 3.6 m in Z, each within about 0.05 m. Add two doors named Door A and Door B; each should have OverallWidth 950 mm and OverallHeight 2200 mm within about 20 mm. Add six windows named Window N 2.6, Window N 5.2, Window N 7.8, Window W 10.8, Window W 13.4, and Window W 16.0. Three windows should be 1200 mm wide by 1200 mm high, and three should be 1800 mm wide by 1400 mm high, each dimension within about 20 mm. Model exactly eight opening elements, eight void relationships, and eight fill relationships so every door or window fills one opening and every opening voids Facade Wall. Other details may vary.
